scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to heterogeneous windmills with at least two peripheral clique blades, each of order at least two. Its proof is symbolic; exhaustive enumeration through order 9 is corroborative only. The scalar minimum is explicitly treated as prior-covered by published join/general theory. Targeted full-text and alias searches found no all-function weight enumerator, but incomplete indexing leaves a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Double Roman weight enumerator of heterogeneous windmills
